title: External warehouse receipt projection
description: Read-only warehouse-receipt whitelist without actor, reason, scan, ledger, evidence, audit, or MISA fields.

status.description: Canonical warehouse-receipt lifecycle (OD-C24-03, owner decision 05-09-2026). CANCELLED and CORRECTED receipts stay in the full snapshot and keep their own token; the provider MUST NOT map them onto CONFIRMED or filter them out. The former BLOCKED/REJECTED tokens were packaging-intake vocabulary and never existed for warehouse receipts.

received_quantity.description: Header roll-up emitted ONLY when every receipt line shares one UOM; omitted otherwise, because summing mixed UOM lines would produce a silently wrong number (OD-C24-03). Absence means 'not expressible as a single quantity', never zero. A CORRECTED receipt keeps the quantity recorded on the receipt itself: correcting a receipt only advances its status, it does not rewrite the receipt lines, so the corrected amount is carried by a separate document. Consumers must not read this field as the post-correction figure.
